sections.title: 11. FAQs about Undergraduate Civil Engineering in Germany

items: Q1. Can Indian students study civil engineering in Germany after 12th?
Yes . Students must satisfy the **German university entrance requirements**. Depending on the qualifications, some may have to complete **Studienkolleg** and pass the evaluation test.
Q2. Do civil engineering studies cost money in Germany?

You’ll still have to pay semester fees, but a number of **public universities** will offer free general tuition for qualified bachelor’s programs. Private universities often charge tuition, but so do some public institutions and states.
Q3. Is it possible to study civil engineering in English in Germany?
While many civil engineering courses for undergraduates are taught in German, there might be some **English-taught options**. **German** language skills may expand course availability.
Q4. How long does it take to get a bachelor's degree in civil engineering in Germany?
Most programs are three to three and a half years depending on the school and curriculum.
Q5. What is the salary in Germany after civil engineering graduation?
The gross starting salary can range between **€38,000 and €50,000 per annum** depending on the position, the employer, the region and the level of practical experience.
